comparison.objective: Remove one terminal block from a loose DIN rail without disturbing neighbours.
comparison.physical_skill: Brace the rail while pushing, tipping, and sliding a snap-fit block free.
comparison.success_condition: Target released and still on tray for 1 s; neighbours remain latched within 1 mm and rail remains within pose limits.
comparison.reason: Both involve protecting retained components, but this tests snap-fit unlatching and whole-part removal rather than impact fracture at a notch and recovery of four fragments.
